how: The Herts & Middlesex branch of Butterfly Conservation runs free guided butterfly walks including sites in Greater London, and London Wildlife Trust and the London Natural History Society run further walks.
Growing Underground grows hydroponic salad leaves and micro-herbs in disused air-raid shelters beneath Clapham; it is a commercial farm and no public workshop was confirmed.
Sneaker Con London is a recurring sneaker collector convention with 300+ vendors and a trading area, held at venues such as ExCeL London.
The Watch Collectors' Club holds free monthly in-person watch meetups in Central London where attendees bring pieces from their collections.
The London International Antique Doll, Teddy Bear and Toy Fair is held at Kensington Town Hall with 100+ stalls of antique and vintage toys.
Clapham Junction, the busiest station in the UK by train count, is a long-standing spotting location, with forum guides naming specific platforms and nearby bridges.
